events.title: Merc Commander Demo is now available!
events.summary: A huge thank you to everyone who took part in the playtest. Thanks to your feedback, I was able to fix a huge number of small issues and polish many of the game's quality-of-life features.The work is, of course, far from finished. I'll continue making changes and improvements based on your feedback.But today, I'm happy to finally present the Merc Commander demo.The demo includes 10 missions and at least two hours of gameplay and can be found here: Play the Merc Commander Demo on Steam Unfortunat

events.title: Merc Commander Playtest is live
events.summary: Good day, everyone.Today, I’d like to invite you to a Merc Commander playtest.For you, this could be an opportunity to get a feel for what the game is about and whether it meets your expectations. For me, it’s a chance to get some feedback.To start off, we’ll begin with 100 players (I don’t want to embarrass myself in front of a large crowd right away).Please feel free to share any thoughts you may have. Bugs, issues, ideas - please let me know about everything.
